text_block_list.text: On the way home from an outing with Yukino Bijin—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, 'scuse me.
Would it be alright if we wrap up here for today?
I kinda wanna get some special training in before I head home...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
An actor's signature!
Even if it's just a tiny role,
I'm joinin' their ranks, after all!

Yukino Bijin was captivated by the radiance
of the actors while watching the drama filming.

Having plucked up the courage to audition for a minor role,
she recently passed with flying colors.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I asked City-san to give me special training
so I can learn how to act properly.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I wanna do whatever it takes so I can put on a super cool performance on the big stage...!
As her Trainer, I definitely wanted to watch over her. I asked the fired-up Yukino Bijin if I could observe her special training.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ow-ow-ow...
M-My arms are starting to shake...!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Just like models, actors need great posture
and carriage to really shine on stage, you know.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Along with the core, we'll train the hip joints and toes—strengthening everything overall so you can hold any posture for a long time.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hai-eeee...!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Keep your gaze straight ahead and maintain a straight posture.
Fully extend your limbs, and imagine moving
from your shoulders and hips.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
With a snap, like this...!
I'll walk over from that side, so please watch me!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Still looking a bit stiff.
Relax your body, make it fluid and graceful.
Keep that in mind while moving.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Mind your posture even during vocal practice.
Just like walking,
project your voice forward as if drawing a straight line into the distance."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: A voice that lacks a solid core and wavers is hard to hear. Even when acting timid, never forget to project your voice clearly.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I-I see~! I'll keep practicing my vocal exercises until I can project my voice properly!

Posing, runway walking, vocal exercises—
Under strict instruction, Yukino Bijin tackled them all one by one.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Alright.
This is a good stopping point, so let's take a break.
Make sure to stay hydrated.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yes! Also, I need to take notes on what you taught me and organize it all...!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...And?
You've had that look on your face like you wanted to say something the whole time.
choice_data_list: I was thinking you're coaching pretty seriously...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Well, yeah.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
She told me,
'I want you to train me so I can become like City-san and the actors.'

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I didn't say I "wanted to become" one.
I said I "will become" one.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: "To baby someone who's prepared to stand on the same field as you just because you're friends would be downright disrespectful, don't you think?"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ...Miss City.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Oh, you're back already.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"I wanna do special training for as long as I can
so I can master what City-san taught me...!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I gotta practice over and over
until City-san acknowledges me!
choice_data_list: You're already a fine actor, Kokorozashi.
You're already a fine actor, Kokorozashi.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I gotta practice over and over
until City-san acknowledges me!
choice_data_list: You're already a fine actor, Kokorozashi.
You're already a fine actor, Kokorozashi.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I-Is that so?!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: You've got a lot to work on, but it's true that you're improving. You've got good potential, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: T-Thank ya kindly!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Still, I won't get ahead of myself and I'll do my best! I'm gonna master everything you've taught me!

Yukino Bijin, resuming her special training with renewed determination,
looked incredibly dependable.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Thank ya for the concern, aye!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Still, if there's someone you wanna become, you've gotta face it head-on...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I don't think you can ever grow
unless you climb over the walls in front of you!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Yeah. The only one who can turn an ideal into reality is myself.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yes! I'll do my best to give a performance that takes the breath away from both you and City-san...!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Fufu, I'm expecting great things.

Seeing Yukino Bijin strive straight toward her goal
warmed my heart.
